blocks.text: Long before us, another world learned to master MRU. Its people built ever larger machines and drew ever more MRU, until the land burned into desert and only a few dim, broken suns were left in the sky. That world is <hl>Hoanna</hl>, the first world MRU destroyed.

Its people are long gone. What remains are ruined towns, catacombs and mine shafts underground, and radiation and strange weather that never lift. The ruins hold void materials you cannot find anywhere here, and the machines ahead of you need them ([[hoanna/relics]]).

Only the wind still remembers the way. Once the wind trusts you, the {item:essentialcraft5:wind_tablet} can turn a lit Nether portal into a Gate to Hoanna: first make the tablet reveal the wind’s true name ([[hoanna/wind_name]]), then open the gate ([[hoanna/open_gate]]).
The letters that slowly appear on the Wind Tablet spell the wind’s true name: Owethanna Else Hugaida. In the original, the wind only opens the way to Hoanna for those who can speak it.

title: The Wind’s Name
summary: No question marks left on the tablet

blocks.text: Goal: turn every question mark on the {item:essentialcraft5:wind_tablet} into a letter.

Hover over the tablet: under “Wind Name:” there is a row of question marks. Every time your wind relation grows a little, one of them turns into a letter; at {cfg:general.wind.tablet_points} the whole name shows and the tablet starts to answer you. Making the tablet: [[wind/wind_tablet]]. Raising your relation: [[wind/air_potion]].

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: The name in the tooltip has no question marks left.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Until the whole name shows, right-clicking a Nether portal with the tablet only gets you “The portal does not respond...”: no MRU is spent and the portal stays as it is.

title: Opening the Gate
summary: Turn a Nether portal green with the tablet

blocks.text: Goal: turn a lit Nether portal in the Overworld into a Gate to Hoanna.

You need: a {item:essentialcraft5:wind_tablet} that shows the wind’s name ([[hoanna/wind_name]]); at least {cfg:general.wind.tablet_portal_mru} MRU, either in the tablet itself or in MRU storage items you carry; and a Nether portal: an obsidian frame with an opening 2 to 21 wide and 3 to 21 tall, any size you like.

items: Build and light a Nether portal in the Overworld. Do not step in yet.
Hold the Wind Tablet and right-click the purple surface of the portal.
The whole portal turns green at once and {cfg:general.wind.tablet_portal_mru} MRU is spent (from your storage items first, then from the tablet).

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: The portal is green and the message above your hotbar says the Gate to Hoanna is open.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Only Overworld portals can be changed, not ones in the Nether, and the portal has to be fully lit. Inside someone else’s claim the change is refused: not a single block changes and no MRU is spent.
A Gate to Hoanna cannot be picked up as an item. Break one obsidian block of the frame and the whole gate is gone, just like a Nether portal; rebuild the frame, light it and change it again.

title: Crossing Over
summary: Stand in the gate for a moment

blocks.text: Goal: set foot in Hoanna for the first time.

items: Walk into the Gate to Hoanna and stand still.

Wait {cfg:general.hoanna.portal_wait_ticks|sec} (instantly in creative). A green glow slowly creeps in from the edges of the screen, without spinning or nausea; if it bothers you, turn down “Distortion Effects”.
You arrive standing in a Gate to Hoanna: if there is one within {cfg:general.hoanna.portal_search_radius} blocks on that side you come out of it, otherwise a new one is built near the matching spot.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: The sky turns dark, the horizon hazy yellow, and the land around you looks like nothing you have seen.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: You cannot pass through while riding; dismount first. After crossing, gates will not take you again for {cfg:general.hoanna.portal_cooldown_ticks|sec}, and the time you spend standing in a gate does not count, so step out first. If every spot to arrive at on the other side is in someone else’s claim, the gate refuses to send you; try again later.
Only players can pass: items you throw in, animals and minecarts all stay where they are.

title: The Way Home
summary: Return gates, beds and mending a gate

blocks.text: Stepping into a Gate to Hoanna in Hoanna takes you back to the same coordinates in the Overworld: if there is a Gate to Hoanna within {cfg:general.hoanna.portal_search_radius} blocks (usually the one you came through) you come out of it.

If there is no Gate to Hoanna nearby in the Overworld (it was broken, or you are too far away), the gate does not build one there. It sends you to your spawn point instead: the bed you last slept in in the Overworld, or the world spawn if there is none.

items: Beds work in Hoanna: sleeping in one sets your spawn point there (it does not skip the night). Respawn anchors do not work in Hoanna.
If you die without having slept in Hoanna, you respawn at your Overworld spawn point.
If your spawn point is in Hoanna and no gate is found on the way back, you land at the world spawn.

blocks.text: If the gate breaks

Nether portals cannot be lit in Hoanna. If the gate on that side is broken, build an empty obsidian frame again and right-click the inside of the frame with the {item:essentialcraft5:wind_tablet} (for example the top of the bottom row): the empty frame turns straight into a Gate to Hoanna. It needs the wind’s name and {cfg:general.wind.tablet_portal_mru} MRU just the same, and inside someone else’s claim it is refused without spending MRU.
